messages.subject: Re: draw line between two points
parts:
How about geom_segment:

dat <- data.frame(var1 = c(1,2), var2 = c(2,1))
ggplot(dat, aes(x = var1, y = var2)) +
  geom_point()  
last_plot() + geom_segment(aes(x = 2, y = 1, xend = 1, yend = 2))
